hook: 3 memory quirks that shape what you remember.
facts: Number one: the *peak-end rule*. You judge by the best moment and the end.
Number two: the *serial position effect*. You recall the first and last items best.
Number three: the *von Restorff effect*. The odd one out sticks in memory.
So end strong, and make *one thing* stand out.
outro: Remember the quirks, remember the ending.
title: Psychology Facts
